channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Trump threatens 200% tariffs on French wine, shares private message from Macron over Greenland row
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened to impose a massive 200 percent tariff on French wine and champagne, escalating tensions with France. The warning came after Paris reportedly decided not to accept Trump's invitation to join his proposed 'Board of Peace.'

item.title: NDRF rushes to Greater Noida site as UP govt removes Noida CEO after techie's death; Congress terms it 'murder'
item.description: An NDRF team reached the site in Greater Noida where a 27-year-old software engineer, Yuvraj Mehta, died after his car plunged into a water-filled, unbarricaded construction pit amid dense fog. Following the incident, the Uttar Pradesh government removed the Noida Authority CEO and ordered a Special Investigation Team (SIT) probe. Congress MP Pramod Tiwari called the death "murder," criticizing the lack of safety measures and rescue preparedness.

item.title: J&K's Kishtwar sees third day of anti-terror operation, locals taken in for questioning
item.description: An anti-terrorist operation in Jammu and Kashmir's Kishtwar district entered its third day on Tuesday, with locals detained for questioning in connection with the case. The operation, codenamed Operation Trashi-I, is focused on Sonnar village in Chatroo, where a Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) terrorist hideout was busted

item.title: 'Should I buy Ryanair?' Elon Musk polls X users after clash with airline CEO
item.description: Elon Musk sparked widespread online attention after posting an X poll asking whether he should buy Ryanair, following a public spat with the airline's CEO Michael O'Leary over Ryanair's decision not to adopt Starlink for in-flight Wi-Fi. The disagreement escalated into personal insults exchanged on social media and in interviews, with Musk using humour and wordplay to fuel the debate.

item.title: 81 pc Indian employers aware of PM-VBRY offering cash incentives: Report
item.description: A TeamLease Services report shows that 81 per cent of Indian employers are aware of the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PM-VBRY), but awareness is uneven across sectors and company sizes, with start-ups and micro businesses showing very low familiarity. While over half of employers plan to expand hiring in the second half of FY26, only about 60 per cent of them know about the scheme

item.title: AR Rahman communal row: Imtiaz Ali says singer's remark is "misconstrued", Taslima Nasreen reacts
item.description: Imtiaz Ali backs AR Rahman after communal remark backlash, while Taslima Nasreen slammed the legend.

item.title: Priyanka Chahar Chaudhary's Naagin 7 face off with dragon irks social media: "Don't ruin the show"
item.description: Netizens urge Ekta Kapoor and Priyanka Chahar Chaudhary's Naagin 7 makers to stop overusing AI and VFX.

item.title: CAQM revokes GRAP-IV restrictions as Delhi air quality improves marginally
item.description: CAQM has lifted GRAP Stage-IV restrictions in Delhi-NCR as air quality improves, with AQI dropping from 440 to 378. Stages I–III remain in effect, while construction sites must stay closed until cleared by the Commission.

item.title: Running Mumbai Marathon next year? Here's how Apple Watch can help you prepare
item.description: With the Mumbai Marathon wrapped up, runners planning for next year can use Apple Watch features like pacing alerts, sleep tracking, and longer battery life to train more consistently and recover better.

item.title: Pending toll dues? No NOC, fitness certificate or permit for vehicles, says govt
item.description: As per the new provisions, a No Objection Certificate will not be issued for transfer of vehicle ownership or for moving a vehicle from one state to another unless all unpaid toll fees are cleared.
